newsitem.title: POLAND: LUCCHINI GROUP TO INVEST 72 MLN ECU IN POLISH UNIT.
newsitem.headline: LUCCHINI GROUP TO INVEST 72 MLN ECU IN POLISH UNIT.

text.p: Italy's Lucchini group will invest 72 million Ecus in a Warsaw-based steel mill it controls, Huta Lucchini Warszawa, during the second stage of the factory's modernisation, Lucchini's president said on Tuesday.

"The next stage of investment in Huta Lucchini will involve modernisation of the rolling mill...The investment will amount to about 72 million Ecu," Luigi Lucchini told a news conference. He did not say when the investment would be completed.
Lucchini has already invested 65 million Ecu in modernisation of the Polish mill, in which it has a 51-percent stake, Lucchini said.
The remaining stakes in the plant belong to WBK, employees, PBR and the treasury.
